notes_for_editor: No source found for a Ridge Road tower in Hall County. Two web searches and the caches turned up only the tnlandforms row. The Gainesville Times pieces are about the Lula tower (GA291), a separate tower; they are cited only to separate the two. The record's status is still unknown and the story does not claim one. The coordinates are the list's; not checked on a map. Unverified lead: the FFLA Georgia/SC chapter report for 2013 (https://firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-rp-gasc-2013.pdf) mentions a planned Georgia tower status list; it was not found. Recommend holding as list-only.
